name: Corpselight Rapier
body:
Aura moderate conjuration; CL 8th; Slot none; Price 21,320 gp; Weight 2 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This +2 undead–bane rapier is ornate and covered with thousands of tiny spirals of Pharasma, with the tail of a single large spiral stretching half the length of the blade. Designed for hunting and dispatching the undead, the unsheathed blade glows when any undead are within a 60-ft. radius.

Unfortunately, its antipathy with undead also acts as a beacon, and undead within 1 mile of the blade can sense its presence and direction, even when the sword is sheathed.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells detect undead, summon monster I; Cost 10,820 gp
